---
description: items_access as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: looking at who may use a thing
arguments:
  who: "The person, by name."
  item: "The thing, by name."
---
Reads whose a thing is, who has it and where, and what lets this person use it or dispose of it: the owner, a group they belong to, a grant, a permit, and who else may use it. Nothing is changed.
